name: The Ritz-Carlton Koh Samui
insider_take: This clifftop sanctuary sits on a former coconut plantation, where ancient granite boulders frame infinity pools that seem to melt into the Gulf of Thailand.
whats_special: The resort features Thailand's first Ritz-Carlton Reserve-style experience with just 175 suites and villas, each boasting private pools and unobstructed ocean views. The property's unique design incorporates massive natural granite formations that are over 3 billion years old, seamlessly blending luxury with Koh Samui's dramatic landscape.
pro_tip: Book the Mu Koh Suite for the ultimate experience – it comes with a dedicated butler and sits on the highest point of the resort, offering 270-degree ocean panoramas that locals say rival any sunset spot in Southeast Asia.
dont_miss: The mystical Grandmother and Grandfather Rocks (Hin Ta & Hin Yai) are just 10 minutes away – these naturally sculpted formations are considered sacred by locals and offer incredible photo opportunities, especially during golden hour when the ancient stones glow against the turquoise waters.
pros: Stunning beachfront location with pristine white sand beach
Luxurious pool villas with private pools and ocean views
Exceptional Ritz-Carlton service and attention to detail
cons: Remote location requires planning for off-property dining
